name: Hero
summary: A view's opening: an eyebrow, the title set large, a lead, the one or two main actions and, if it helps, a picture. For a landing page or the opening of a long page's section. Not for the head of an ordinary or documentation page (use PageHeader) or for a section's heading (use Section).
a11y: A `header` with the title as its heading at `level`; the eyebrow is plain text before it, in reading order. The picture or media follows the words in the source, so the reading order is the same in every arrangement; the trail comes last. The actions are real Buttons or button-styled links; the note is plain text after them.

props.name: title
props.description: The page's or section's title, set in the display size: the one display heading in the view.

props.name: level
props.description: `1` (default) when the hero opens the page; `2` when it opens a section of a longer page.

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: A short line above the title naming what it belongs to, e.g. "Design systems".

props.name: lead
props.description: One or two sentences under the title: what this is and why it matters.

props.name: actions
props.description: One or two Buttons, the main one first: what most people came to do.

props.name: note
props.description: A quieter line after the actions: a condition or a status, e.g. "Free for teams of up to five."

props.name: trail
props.description: What follows the opening inside it (IP19), across its width: a row of partner marks, key facts, a cue to what's below. A section level after the words and picture.

props.name: fit
props.description: `content` (default): as tall as its parts. `screen`: fills the first screen, the window's height less the sticky header and the layout's first space, with the opening centred in it; taller content grows it.

props.name: reserve
props.description: Keeps room for this many lines of the title and of the lead (MP7), so a series of openings (a project's pages, a year's books) keeps one height and what follows one place. Longer text still grows the opening; it never clips. A reserved lead with no lead keeps its room empty.

props.name: layout
props.description: `split` (default with a picture): words and picture side by side, stacking when the room is narrow. `stacked` (default without one): the words, then the picture below and wide, or the words alone.

props.name: picture
props.description: A picture given room. Leave it out and the title carries the view.

props.name: media
props.description: Any media in the picture's place (IP19): a MediaPlayer, a Carousel, an ImageGrid, your own arrangement of pictures. It takes the picture's room and arrangement; give it its own words (alt text, a player's label). Use `picture` for one picture: it brings the frame, ratio and focal point.

props.name: alt
props.description: What the picture shows, for people who can't see it; empty only if it adds nothing the words don't say.

props.name: focal
props.description: The point to keep in view when the frame crops (IP12): `x` and `y` from 0 to 1, as `Image` `focal`.

props.name: priority
props.description: The page's first and largest picture: loads ahead of the rest (`Image` `priority`).

props.name: decoration
props.description: Shapes over the picture (MP9), as `Image` `decoration`: hidden from screen readers, never in the way, may spill past its edge.
